datasets.title: Repeated facts and repeated failures: consolidation under the offline default
datasets.description: Exact repeats, paraphrases and a repeated failure. The dataset opts into the M14 consolidation pass: contradiction resolution and decay run (fixtures are minutes old, so decay archives nothing), while the vector-gated passes (episodic-to-semantic derivation, near-duplicate merge) skip with recorded warnings because the offline default wires no embedder. The paraphrase pair therefore stays distinct offline — the honest measured ceiling of consolidation quality in the no-embedding default.

datasets.title: Contradictory facts: automatic authority resolution (M14)
datasets.description: Mutually exclusive statements in one project, ingested WITHOUT declared supersessions and resolved by the automatic contradiction pass (explicit > decision > newer > confidence; a full tie marks both sides disputed). The dataset opts into the M14 consolidation pass; the offline harness runs contradiction resolution and decay, while the vector-gated passes (derivation, near-duplicate merge) skip with recorded warnings. Groups cover every authority level plus one full tie, and one cross-phrasing pair the template heuristic cannot detect (the documented detector gap).

datasets.title: Memory pollution: archived-but-cited (stale) and near-duplicate memories that surfaced in retrieval
datasets.description: M11b-quality pollution fixture. Observations are 60 days old (base_time 60 days before now) and the dataset opts into the M14 consolidation pass with decay.archiveThreshold raised to 0.2 — high enough to archive the low-prominence 60-day-old version fact (episodic half-life 30d), far below every explicit statement's prominence. The point-in-time probe then still serves that archived memory (as-of queries include archived rows) and REINFORCES it, producing the honest stale state the pollution audit detects: status 'archived' but cited within the last 30 days. The two procedural statements differ only in capitalization, so ingest's content-hash dedupe keeps both while their deterministic vectors are cosine-identical — the near-duplicate pair the offline merge pass (vector-gated, no embedder) leaves behind, and the third statement is the negative control (same type and project, dissimilar wording, must NOT flag).
